lesson: Reads Jira via curl + API token (NOT the Atlassian MCP - it's broken in this env). Required env: JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_API_TOKEN (per jira-api-access.mdc). Flattens ADF description to plain text and harvests labels / components / comments. Tries to extract bullet-style acceptance criteria; if none are found, signal NEEDS_INPUT instead of guessing.
